resources.string:
Volimiter helps limit media volume when audio is playing through the device speaker.
What Volimiter controls: • Media volume while the device speaker is in use • A foreground service that monitors media volume while active • Optional restart after device reboot • PIN protection before stopping Volimiter • Optional Device Admin permission to make Volimiter harder to remove while active
What Volimiter does not do: • It does not record audio • It does not use the microphone • It does not upload your PIN or settings • It does not limit headphone or Bluetooth volume • It does not hide itself from the launcher
Only enable Device Admin if you understand that it may prevent normal uninstallation until Volimiter is stopped with the PIN.

Volimiter uses Device Admin permission to make the app harder to uninstall while it is active. This is intended for parent-managed or self-control use. To uninstall Volimiter, first open the app, enter the PIN, and stop Volimiter.
Volimiter stores your PIN and volume settings locally on this device. It does not record audio, use the microphone, collect personal information, or send data to a server.
